mostWorthwhile.text: Showing Moth the rejection was most worthwhile: its cached map connected the clinic's problem to a wider service gap and showed how an outdated directory can guide decisions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Replacing the display ribbon was clear but predictable; it felt like another straightforward repair step rather than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: Moth's cached map treated the neighborhood as a service gap and would direct delivery vans elsewhere, showing how the bad directory propagates into practical advice.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the offered compatible combinations made the repair sequence fairly prescribed.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how June and the neighbors challenge the service gap, although I hope the next chapter offers more consequential choices.
